changes.to: Maker press release (26 Mar 2020): EMIEW4 height 90 cm, mass 18 kg, max movement speed 5 km/h (field = 1.39 m/s), languages Japanese/English/Chinese/Korean, automated recharging for continuous operation, domestic sales from 20 Apr 2020 through Hitachi Building Systems, delivered about 4 months after order, price by individual quotation. It runs on wheels and does not walk. DoF, payload, runtime and battery figures are not published.
Hitachi's wheeled communication humanoid for building reception, guidance and night patrol, sold in Japan from April 2020 with automated recharging.
